$comment: Pinned settings for every loop-supervisor iteration. Passed as `claude --settings`, so an unattended run does not inherit whatever the operator's local settings happen to say today. Permission mode is acceptEdits: NOT plan mode (which has killed 4 of 5 pipelines in a live batch — a planning agent asks and then waits, and nobody is there to answer), and NOT --dangerously-skip-permissions (an unattended loop with no approval boundary at all is not a tradeoff worth making for the same outcome).
